#### 3. Kilocode config discovery refactor #15282 REFERENCE-ONLY (config, seam, isolation, v2-migration)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #15282 (merged 2026-10-21) moves Kilo config discovery behind generic `LayoutService` seam for internal v2 release. Issue: PR #15018 commit `4c51aabf0d8` put Kilo config discovery into upstream files (Core imported Kilo module, 6 upstream tests changed to Kilo fixtures). Internal-release decision requires isolation from v1: `kilo2` binary must read/write `kilo2` config (`kilo2.json`, `~/.config/kilo2/`, `.kilo2/`) not shared project `.kilo` or `kilo.json`. Fix: upstream discovery gets generic `LayoutService` node with upstream defaults (`names`, `directories`, `directoryFiles`, `walk`). Kilo host supplies internal-release values through existing overrides: `KiloHost.overrides` replaces `ConfigDiscovery.node` with `KiloConfigDiscovery.layout`. Names and orders are Kilo-owned (`packages/util/src/kilocode/config/files.ts`). Automatic-update policy reads `kilo2.json(c)`, last defined policy wins. Six upstream config tests reverted to byte-identical upstream v2.1.0 (`9d90d892dcb`). Shared-patch delta: 32→27 files, 288→204 marked lines, 39 unmarked lines unchanged, 0 deleted shared files. Core Kilo imports drop to zero in discovery + config. Pattern: isolate product-specific config paths behind a generic seam (layout node with names/directories/walk interface) so upstream core never imports host-specific modules.

- **Why**: Alexi is not a Kilo fork and does not need v1/v2 data isolation. Alexi already uses distinct config paths (`~/.alexi/`, `routing-config.json`, `~/.alexi/sessions/`) with no OpenCode or Kilo v1 legacy. No shared `.kilo` / `.opencode` conflict. REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi adds multi-version data isolation (e.g. `alexi-beta` separate from `alexi-stable` for concurrent preview builds, or enterprise multi-tenant deployments with per-tenant config roots), reference this pattern for config discovery service replacement: (1) define generic layout interface with `names` (config filenames), `directories` (config search paths), `directoryFiles` (subdirectory config files), `walk` (search algorithm), (2) core config discovery uses layout node with upstream defaults, (3) host overrides replace layout with product-specific values via `overrides` layer composition, (4) CLI config writers (MCP add, plugin install, updater policy) call into shared util module with product-specific names. Benefits: zero Core imports of product modules, upstream tests remain byte-identical to upstream pin, automatic-update policy reads correct filename. Current priority SKIP — Alexi config paths are already isolated from OpenCode/Kilo, no multi-version isolation needed, no Kilo fork.

#### 5. Cline plugin catalog reliability #15224 REFERENCE-ONLY (plugin, catalog, hub, per-request-freshness, eviction)

- **What**: Cline PR #15224 (merged 2026-10-20) replaces global Hub event stream subscription with per-request fingerprinting for plugin catalog reliability. Issue: every Hub client received whole Hub event stream (global subscription to `plugins.commands.changed` event, session events arrived twice, per-listener 4096-entry event ID cache in `NodeHubClient` hid duplicates). Workspace catalog had recursive file watchers, debounced source checks, exponential retry timers, per-path loading with priority re-selection, two-pass reconcile loop. Re-fingerprinted plugin sources on every request anyway, so watchers only fed push notifications. Catalogs never evicted (Hub long-lived, every workspace kept plugin workers until Hub stopped). Fix: (1) removed `pluginCommands.subscribe`, `plugins.commands.changed` event, global subscription, dedupe cache (NodeHubClient event delivery back to main's behavior). (2) Workspace catalog is small per-workspace catalog: every request fingerprints enabled discoverable entries + import graphs, reloads when changed. Entry list already excludes disabled plugins, so unrelated preference changes do not restart catalogs. Setup logs + state files beside plugin do not trigger reload. Each load uses own `PluginRegistry` (import failure cannot block live session's copy of same plugin in shared process registry, retry re-imports plugin previous load blocked). Failed load keeps healthy commands, reports `status: "error"`, retried after 30s. Plugins load through `resolveAndLoadAgentPlugins` (precedence matches session bootstrap). (3) Catalogs idle for 10min now release workers. Eviction and disposal wait for running handlers. Clients re-list instead of subscribing (CLI reloads suggestions on mount + active session change, Desktop composers re-list on slash menu open, cached plugin suggestions keyed by session). Pattern: per-request freshness + isolated plugin registry per catalog + 30s retry on failure + idle eviction + no global event stream.

- **Why**: Alexi plugin system (`src/plugin/`) is file-based (load from `~/.alexi/plugins/` or project `.alexi/plugins/`), no Hub subscription, no shared process registry, no long-lived plugin catalog service, no Desktop/VS Code extension. CLI loads plugins on session start, no background refresh. REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi adds long-lived plugin catalog service (e.g. background service with plugin command index for slash-command completion, shared catalog across multiple CLI sessions, hot-reload on plugin file change), reference this pattern for reliability: (1) per-request fingerprinting instead of file watchers (fingerprint enabled plugin entries + import graphs, reload when changed, exclude disabled plugins from fingerprint so unrelated settings changes do not reload, exclude setup logs/state files beside plugin). (2) Isolated plugin registry per catalog load (import failure cannot block shared registry, retry re-imports blocked plugin, failed load keeps healthy commands + reports error status + retries after 30s). (3) Idle eviction (release workers after 10min idle, wait for running handlers before disposal). (4) Clients re-list instead of subscribing (no global event stream, no dedupe cache, keyed by session for context). Current priority SKIP — Alexi plugins load on session start only, no background catalog service, no hot-reload surface, no Hub. Pattern reference for future plugin catalog service.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15224 (plugin catalog reliability upstream, merged 2026-10-20), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/plugin/ (Alexi plugin system, file-based, no Hub), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Alexi architecture, CLI-only, no Desktop/VS Code)

- **Category**: N/A (plugin, catalog, hub, per-request-freshness, eviction, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi plugin system is file-based, no background catalog service. Pattern reference for future long-lived plugin catalog with hot-reload.

Pattern: detect project metadata (icon/logo) from standard locations (`.appiconset`, favicon, etc.), cache as data URL with size cap, diff by content hash (write only on change), respect user override (override + colour precedence over detected icon).

REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi adds desktop/web GUI with project list (e.g. Electron app or web dashboard with sessions grouped by project, showing project logos), reference this pattern for icon detection: (1) fixed candidate paths (`.appiconset`, `favicon.ico`, `logo.png`, etc.), (2) real-path containment (symlink escape prevention), (3) image-extension allowlist (`.png`, `.jpg`, `.svg`, etc.), (4) 64 KB cap on both input file and encoded data URL (prevent oversized images from bloating DB), (5) fork discovery when project resolves (background process), (6) compare content hashes against stored data URL (write only when changed, no redundant DB writes), (7) respect user override (stored `icon_url_override` + `icon_color` take precedence over detected icon, discovery never overwrites user choice). Current priority SKIP — Alexi CLI-only, no GUI project list, no icon display surface. Pattern reference for future desktop/web GUI.

#### 7. SST V1 migration fix #57618 REFERENCE-ONLY (migration, path-normalization, relative-path, fallback)

- **What**: SST OpenCode PR #57618 (merged 2026-10-21) fixes V1→V2 migration throwing `Path is not absolute: .` when old ACP sessions had `directory = '.'`. Issue: V1 `session` table can have relative `directory` (e.g. `'.'`). V1→V2 migration copied that value into `session_v2`, then read it back through `directoryColumn`, which threw on relative path. Transaction rolled back along with cursor update, so migration retried same row on every launch and never finished. Fix: before copy, a directory that isn't a stored absolute path is replaced with session's project worktree (best stand-in for unknown V1 working directory, which was relative to ACP process's working directory at time). Original V1 row left unchanged. Shared check `storedAbsolutePath(input)` between migration and `directoryColumn` so they cannot drift (exported from `database/path.ts`, returns normalized path or undefined if relative; `absolute(input)` throws when `storedAbsolutePath` returns undefined). Pattern: migration data normalization (relative paths → absolute fallback), shared validation between migration + runtime, log replacements, leave original unchanged.

- **Why**: Alexi does not migrate from OpenCode V1 (fresh session storage in `~/.alexi/sessions/`, no ACP legacy). Alexi sessions store directory as absolute path (verified `src/session/` modules, no relative path handling). REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi imports sessions from other tools (Kilo, Cline, OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf), reference this pattern for path normalization during migration: (1) before copying session row, check if directory is stored absolute path (not empty, not relative like `.` or `./src`), (2) if relative, replace with best fallback (project worktree, or empty string if worktree not absolute), (3) log replacement ("Replaced relative V1 session directory"), (4) leave original V1 row unchanged (non-destructive migration), (5) share validation check (`storedAbsolutePath` or equivalent) between migration code + runtime column decoder so they cannot drift (migration uses same check as runtime, preventing future regression). Benefits: migration robustness (does not throw on unexpected relative paths), non-destructive (original data preserved), shared validation (no drift between migration + runtime). Current priority SKIP — Alexi does not migrate from V1, no session import from other tools. Pattern reference for future session import.

- **Source**: https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/57618 (V1 migration fix upstream, merged 2026-10-21), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/session/ (Alexi session storage, no V1 migration), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Alexi architecture, fresh session storage)

- **Category**: N/A (migration, path-normalization, relative-path, fallback, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi does not migrate from V1. Pattern reference for future session import from other tools.
